title: UneceExperienceFacility
description:
A structure or place, such as a restaurant, hotel, theme park, hot spring bathing pool, parking lot, or meeting room,
that provides a particular experience.

architecturalStyle.description: An architectural style, expressed as text, of this experience facility.

availableRoute.description: An available route specified for this experience facility.

completionDateTime.description: The date of the completion of this experience facility.

description.description: A textual description of this experience facility.

experienceFacilityTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of experience facility.

facilityType.description: A type, expressed as text, of this experience facility.

identifier.description: The identifier of this experience facility.

latestRenovationDateTime.description: The date of the latest renovation of this experience facility.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this experience facility.

physicalSpecifiedLocation.description: A physical location specified for this experience facility.

specifiedCommunication.description: A specified universal communication for this experience facility.

usedSource.description: A water source used by this experience facility.
